tools.name: search_objects
tools.description: Search the obbjects catalog of isolated object images on a plain white background. Returns matches with image_url (1024px square WebP on white), transparent_png_url (same image with a transparent background, for placing on colored slides or pages; null if the object has none), thumbnail_url, license

tools.name: request_object
tools.description: Ask obbjects to add an object it doesn't have yet. Use after search_objects finds no good match. Requests are reviewed and the most wanted objects are photographed or sourced first. Nothing is returned now; search again later.

tools.name: get_object
tools.description: Get one object by id, with image URLs, license and attribution.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List object categories in the catalog with how many objects each has. Browse one with search_objects, setting category and leaving query empty.
